ui_bugs.issue: FIX VERIFY 2 STILL BROKEN. After customer login, tapping bn-bookings on landing routes to URL http://localhost:3001/(customer)/orders but page-title renders '(customer)' instead of 'My Bookings'. Root cause: useLocalSearchParams() on expo-router web returns params.tab = '(customer)' (the route-group name) rather than the actual dynamic segment 'orders'. The current code `const seg = String(params.tab || pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).filter(x => !x.startsWith('(')).pop() || '')` uses params.tab directly, so seg='(customer)' → NAV.find fails → title falls back to seg.replace(/_/g,' ') = '(customer)'. Fix: treat a params.tab value that starts with '(' as empty and fall through to the pathname parser, e.g. `const rawTab = String(params.tab || ''); const tab = rawTab.startsWith('(') ? '' : rawTab; const seg = tab || pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).filter(x => !x.startsWith('(')).pop() || '';` Then NAV.find(n => n.key === 'orders') → 'My Bookings'.

rca of the issue: Bug: bn-bookings page-title shows '(customer)'. Location: /app/Customer/app/(customer)/[tab].tsx line 14. On expo-router web, when the URL is /(customer)/orders and the file is (customer)/[tab].tsx, useLocalSearchParams() sometimes returns params.tab equal to the parent group name '(customer)' during the first render (before the dynamic segment is resolved) — this leaks into the placeholder title. The existing fallback that filters route-group segments from pathname is bypassed because params.tab is truthy. Mitigation (1-line fix): treat a params.tab value starting with '(' as empty. `const rawTab = String(params.tab || ''); const tabParam = rawTab.startsWith('(') ? '' : rawTab; const seg = tabParam || pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).filter(x => !x.startsWith('(')).pop() || '';`
